items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Dick Fitzgerald. Yeah, we had a trio, you know. And we played quite a bit.

ctx.x: He's not from New Orleans, so it doesn't matter, huh?

No, no. He wasn't from New Orleans, he was from Chicago. Dick Fitzgerald, that's what he was. Dick Fitzgerald. Dick Fitzgerald. Yeah, we had a trio, you know. And we played quite a bit. We were about two years out on the road between the Sullivan Continent Circus and the Orphium. And there was another circuit in those days. I forget what it was. So, we...

What was this business? You know, they have these cabarets. I hear people talk about the Haymarket and the Pup and Toros and Peg Olmsteads. And they talk about the Tango Belt, these things being in the Tango Belt.
